services.name: The Midwest Clinic
services.desc: Celebrate the end of summer and welcome autumn with members of Pershing’s Own. The program includes ensembles of varying size and instrumentation, performing works by Jen Oliverop, Rebecca Clark, Antonín Dvořák, and more. Free and open to the public. Musicians from the Concert Band perform music for chamber groups. Free and open to the public. No tickets required. An Addams Family-Friendly Halloween Concert. Make a plan to attend after The Old Guard Fall Fest on Fort Myer! The U.S. Army Concert Band and Army Chorus concert is free and open to the public; tickets are available through the Hylton Center for the Performing Arts box office starting Tuesday, August 4 at 10 AM. Walk-ins welcome
